overview: The Affordable Housing Trust Fund Board reviewed proposed fractional payment ordinance language, received updates on funding requests and municipal presentations, and discussed strategies for expanding trust fund revenue.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The board approved the minutes from the November 5 meeting.

items.title: Fractional Payments Ordinance
items.summary: The board reviewed proposed ordinance language allowing fractional cash payments in lieu of building whole affordable housing units and voted to submit a letter of support to the City Council incorporating requested edits.

items.title: Update on CPC Presentation
items.summary: Staff and members reviewed the Trust's November 18 presentation requesting $550,000 from the Community Preservation Committee, with funding decisions expected shortly.

items.title: Update on Five-Year Action Plan Presentation
items.summary: The board discussed public and City Council feedback following the December 2 presentation of the Trust's five-year action plan.

items.title: 703 Fellsway West Development Update
items.summary: Staff announced that certificates of occupancy were issued for 703 Fellsway West and invited trustees to a ribbon-cutting ceremony scheduled for December 18.

items.title: Trust Revenue and Fundraising Strategy
items.summary: The board discussed potential funding streams, including donations, resale fees, and developer payments, and agreed to seek Massachusetts Housing Partnership technical assistance for voluntary fundraising.
